definition: Use the officially captured 2026 NFL schedule rows (preseason, regular season, postseason anchors) as the fixed list of games to price. No game is priced that is not an official released row.
verification: VERIFIED — cross-checked 2026-11-13 against the live injury report and Week 11 slate

definition: Fit team quality ratings from official performance data (NFL.com team stats; official Next Gen Stats tracking metrics). Ratings must be fit from historical official data and reported with an out-of-sample error estimate before any line is published.
inputs: NFL.com stats hub; NGS official stats
verification: INPUT SOURCES VERIFIED LIVE 2026-11-13; rating model NOT BUILT

definition: Convert weekly practice participation and game statuses (DNP / Limited / Full / Out / Questionable) plus roster churn (trades, reserve list) into per-unit availability adjustments for each team.
verification: INPUT SOURCES VERIFIED LIVE; adjustment weights are DESIGN PARAMETERS — PROPOSED (owner decision required)

definition: When a starter is unavailable, apply the starter-vs-backup quality gap for the specific unit (2nd/3rd/4th string). Official depth ordering is not published on NFL.com team pages (IR-023); starter/backup classification must come from official club announcements and roster status.
inputs: Rosters (ACT status); injury report; club announcements
verification: Depth-order source UNVERIFIED — IR-023; method defined, values NOT COMPUTED

definition: Combine base rating + availability + depth adjustments into a projected margin and total for each game; convert to spread/total/moneyline probabilities. This produces the site's own numbers — explicitly labeled OUR MODEL, never a market line.
verification: SYSTEM DEFINITION — no numeric outputs exist yet

definition: Compare own numbers against licensed market odds to find material deltas; benchmark every graded result against the closing line (CLV). Requires an owner-approved odds source — no official NFL source publishes odds (IR-025).
inputs: Own model; licensed odds feed (owner decision Q2)
output: Delta list + CLV per graded bet

definition: Convert model probability p to fair decimal odds (1/p) and fair American odds; a bet is only publishable when the model price beats the available price by more than the validation-gate margin. Formula is a system definition, not a sourced fact.
No own line is published until every applicable validation gate (V1–V8) passes for the strategy family that produced it. Failed or unrun gates keep the line unpublished.
